A.parser: ODL v12 + full review (live published versions)
A.reading: excerpt search with the six Part 1 fixes

B.parser: MinerU 4.0, tier confirmed at smoke (standard expected); no transcription review, no tags; 3% audit measured only
B.reading: section reading: book outline, ordered section reads, tag-free search as locator
B.database: scratch pgvector intake-eval-scratch on 127.0.0.1:15445 (55443 is inside a Windows reserved port range)

lsj.title: Learning Statistics with jamovi: A Tutorial for Beginners in Statistical Analysis

runs.driver: POST /api/turn sequentially per playground process; generic requests send the confirmation as a second turn with the first turn's history, checkpoint and ledger
counters: quiz questions copied from the bank vs written

measures: per-claim fidelity against rendered cited pages
pairwise coherence and fit A vs B, A vs C
multi-chapter: chapters completed, notation consistency, no repeated explanations, input tokens per chapter

audit.unit: block judged faithful or not against the page image

decision_rule: If C beats A on coherence with no fidelity loss, section reading ships on current data regardless of parser.
B replaces intake for new books only if its audit error rate <= the reviewed text's on the same pages, fidelity not worse than A, cost per material <= 2x A.
If B's text is worse but C wins, keep ODL + page transcription and drop tagging.
amendments: bench/rag/intake/fixtures/protocol-amendments.json (created only if something changes after the first run)

mineru.install: WSL Ubuntu venv ~/mineru-venv, pip mineru[full] (torch 2.13.0+cu130, vllm 0.28.0)
mineru.vlm: MinerU2.5-Pro-2605-1.2B on vLLM, gpu_memory_utilization 0.75 (MinerU default for an 8 GB card), VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0 (no nvcc in WSL)
mineru.output: mineru-kit parse --format zip: markdown.md, middle_json.json (docvortex.middle 2.0; pages[].blocks[] with type, bbox 0..1, content spans; equations as LaTeX), structured_content.json, model_output.json, images/
